files.description: C# project file for the Security Service.
Main entry point for the Security Service application.
Dockerfile for building the Security Service container.
files.code:
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:6.0 AS base
WORKDIR /app
EXPOSE 8080

FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:6.0 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY ["SecurityService/SecurityService.csproj", "./"]
RUN dotnet restore "./SecurityService.csproj"
COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/"
RUN dotnet build "SecurityService.csproj" -c Release -o /app/build

FROM build AS publish
RUN dotnet publish "SecurityService.csproj" -c Release -o /app/publish

FROM base AS final
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "SecurityService.dll"]

files.code:
# Security Service

This service handles authentication, authorization, and security checks.

## Build and Run

```bash
# Build the Docker image
$ docker build -t security-service .

# Run the Docker container
$ docker run -p 8080:8080 security-service
```

## Endpoints

- Health Check: `GET /health`
- Readiness Check: `GET /ready`
- Authentication: `GET /api/security/authenticate`
- Authorization: `GET /api/security/authorize`

implementations.notes: This component implements basic health and readiness endpoints along with placeholder endpoints for authentication and authorization. The Dockerfile is configured to build and run the .NET Core application, exposing port 8080 by default.

files.code:
# Data Access Service

This service manages database interactions and data persistence using Entity Framework Core.

## Build and Run

```bash
# Build the Docker image
docker build -t data-access-service .

# Run the Docker container
# Ensure to set the PORT environment variable if you want to change the default port
# Example: docker run -e PORT=8080 -p 8080:8080 data-access-service

docker run -p 8080:8080 data-access-service
```

## Endpoints

- `GET /health`: Returns the health status of the service.
- `GET /ready`: Returns the readiness status of the service.

implementations.notes: This C# service uses Entity Framework Core to manage database interactions. It includes health and readiness endpoints and is configured for Docker deployment. The service is prepared to be extended with specific DbSet definitions for the banking domain.
